variantInfo.name: Frost dragon
notes: Attacks with melee and short-ranged icy dragonfire.
Frost dragons max hit 16 with stab melee and 50 with dragonfire.
Has 230 Hitpoints, level 180 Attack, level 150 Strength, level 150 Defence, and level 150 Magic.
Weakest melee defence is crush, then stab; slash is much worse.
Has a 100% elemental weakness to fire spells.
Heavy ranged remains the best ranged category, but frost dragons are more resistant to ranged than chromatic dragons.
Dragonbane weapons work because frost dragons have the Dragon attribute.
Slayer XP is 235.5 and the NPC id is 14922.

locationComparison.name: Grimstone Dungeon
notes: Main Frost dragon area in Grimstone Dungeon.
The monster page lists 20 Frost dragon spawns in the main Grimstone Dungeon area.
Frost dragons are immune to dwarf multicannon damage.
Can be safespotted because they only use melee and short-ranged dragonfire.

taskNotes: Frost dragons require 87 Sailing to access Grimstone and 85 combat to receive as a Slayer assignment.
The wiki slayer infobox leaves the Slayer skill requirement blank; the source uses slayerLevel 1 to represent no Slayer skill requirement.
They can be assigned by Nieve/Steve and Duradel/Kuradal.
The fastest return after visiting Grimstone at least once is fairy ring DLP.
A boat moored at Grimstone with a greater teleport focus can also be used, or players can sail from a nearby port such as Weiss.
Frost dragons attack with melee and short-ranged dragonfire.
Their dragonfire is icy and briefly freeze players who lack adequate dragonfire protection.
A regular antifire potion partially negates the icy dragonfire.
A regular antifire potion with an anti-dragon shield fully negates the icy dragonfire.
A super antifire potion alone fully negates the icy dragonfire.
Protect from Melee combined with full dragonfire protection nullifies all Frost dragon damage.
Frost dragons can be Safespotted because they only use melee and short-ranged dragonfire.
They are weakest to crush, then stab, and have a 100% elemental weakness to fire spells.
Heavy ranged remains the best ranged option, though Frost dragons are more resistant to ranged than chromatic dragons.
As dragons, they are weak to dragonbane weapons.
Being on a Frost dragon task increases the Dragon metal sheet drop rate from 1/100 to 1/40.
They have high drop rates for Dragon metal sheets and Dragon nails.
Loot from Frost dragons appears on their central north-eastern tile instead of the south-western tile used by most monsters.
Frost dragons do not count as blue dragons or metal dragons for Slayer tasks.
A task-only area is west of the main Grimstone Dungeon area and blocks off-task kills with a strange coldness message.
recommendedMethod: Use dragonbane melee on crush with Protect from Melee and full dragonfire protection, or use Ranged/Magic safespots. 87 Sailing and Grimstone access are required.
